description: Render a native vector chart (pdfnative v1.6 via add_chart). A grouped bar chart with two series, categories, gridlines and a custom hex palette — pure PDF path operators, zero rasterisation, with an auto-generated tagged-PDF /Figure /Alt. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders. For a chart embedded amongst other content, add a 'chart' block to generate_basic_pdf instead.
